title: Rider Claims Guidance: Waiver of Premium on Whole Life Insurance
content:
**Benefit.** Where the waiver of premium rider is available on the tier and the rider is attached to the Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, installments falling due on or after the disability onset date are waived while total disability continues, if the disability began before the anniversary at the rider's expiry age.

**Elimination period.** A waiver is applied only when the claim decision date is not earlier than the disability onset date plus the tier's elimination period in calendar months. The elimination end is found by adding the number of calendar months to the disability onset date, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist; a decision dated on the elimination end qualifies. The onset date and the decision date are those recorded on the waiver of premium claim.

**Approval.** Premiums are waived only under a waiver of premium claim whose request status is approved.

**Once per installment.** Each installment is waived at most once, and installments for that period already paid are refunded. An installment is identified by the policy and its due date.

**Effect.** Waived premiums count as paid for dividends and cash values but not toward the cost basis.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, elimination period of 6 months)

| Disability onset | Elimination end | Decision dated | Waiver applied |
|---|---|---|---|
| April 10 | October 10 | October 10 | Yes |
| April 10 | October 10 | October 9 | No |
| August 31 | February 28 (February 29 in a leap year) | February 28 in a non-leap year | Yes |

**Paid installments.** Where the monthly installments due May 10 and June 10 fall due after an onset of April 10 and were paid before the claim was approved, each is waived once and the amounts paid for them are refunded.
